name: Alacrian Armory — "choose up to one target Mount or Vehicle" is not a list of modes
notes: Memory: project_audit_small_clusters_round_eight_2026-10-11. The inline-choice rewrite ("choose first strike, vigilance, or lifelink. …") also took "choose up to one target Mount or Vehicle you control. …" for a choice of modes, which made the card modal and switched off its static "Creatures you control get +0/+1 and have vigilance". A choice that names a target is not rewritten.
